decisions.reason: Despite its distance from the core and lack of visible traction, accumulated sunk costs, the previous public commitment, and the need to justify the 2024 keep decision sustain escalation pressure, making a drop possible but not likely.
Because it builds directly on the established crew recruitment offer and aligns with the announced integrated maritime solutions, prior investments and public commitment make persistence likely.

Its successful expansion of the Smart Academy partner network and fit with the firm's training and crewing base reinforce sunk-cost and public-commitment escalation, so it is very unlikely to be dropped.
As a close-to-core compliance service with a successful FuelEU deadline delivery, it is central to the firm's environmental direction and has strong public commitment, making drop highly unlikely.

The dashboard is fully integrated into the firm's PAL software and central to the announced digitalisation and environmental performance direction, so accumulated investment and visibility make dropping very improbable.
Like the dashboard, the simulator is integrated into PAL and publicly presented as part of the environmental compliance toolset, so escalation pressures keep it.
